method: Figures extracted from the city's audited ACFR (FY2025, via Nov 25, 2025 commission packet), the adopted FY2025-26 budget, and computed GL totals. Every number is labeled with its source; figures not found in the notes are marked 'needs additional documentation', not estimated.

fy2025.source: ACFR FY2025 via Nov 25, 2025 commission packet (Finance Director memo)

fy2024.source: Derived: $7,281,401 minus the $537,519 FY2025 increase reported in the Finance Director memo

change_fy2025.source: Finance Director memo to commission, Nov 25, 2025 packet

general_fund_balance.benchmark_note: Typical municipal benchmark is ~25% (two months of spending); EGR at ~53% is well above it. Source: findings-memo.md.

recent_bond_sales.source: Adopted FY2025-26 budget; matches $1,735,000 bond proceeds on 372-000-6980.00 in FY2025 GL

proposed_parking_bond.source: Official special-meeting minutes (resolutions 2026-147/147-A); commissioner's secondary write-up for ballot text

debt.note: Outstanding principal by issue and the full debt-service schedule were not in the research notes.

db_pension_contribution.note: Why the contribution fell is not in the files — needs actuarial data.

pension.note: The pension trust fund (731) exists in the GL with $1.68M FY2025 benefit payments, but the ACFR's net pension liability and funded ratio were not captured in the research notes.

opeb.note: OPEB medical claims tripled ($59,967 -> $187,942); cause not in the files.
